text: Agreed to hold steady endurance effort on climbs rather than surging, keeping breathing conversational and cadence comfortable through the middle hours of rides. Repeated across multiple check-ins as a core pacing principle.
Final riser feeling harder than usual attributed to headwind combined with fatigue from a long day on feet — not a sign of fitness trending the wrong way. No plan adjustment made.

Agreed to tuck lower on bars on the exposed river stretch in wind and to rotate snack schedule earlier to avoid fading in the final hour. Flagged hands and shoulders as comfort markers to watch as weekly volume increases.
